 SOXL Price Prediction: Momentum remains weak despite heavy trading
 Direxion Semiconductor Bull 3X Tokenized ETF (SOXL) was quoted at $75.77, up 5.74% over the latest 24-hour period in the supplied market data. The same source set shows strong trading activity, but...
 Tony Kim 
 Nov 4, 2026 14:00 UTC 
 Market analysis includes conditional scenarios, not assured price outcomes or investment advice. Check the data, assumptions and dates cited.
 In this article
 What happened and why it matters
 According to the supplied market observations, Direxion Semiconductor Bull 3X Tokenized ETF (SOXL) was priced at $75.77, with a 24-hour gain of 5.74% and an intraday range of $78.51 to $65.47. The same source set reports 24-hour volume of $5,517,636,566 from Binance futures market observations. That combination shows active trading, but not yet a clean recovery in the broader trend.
 The ETF remained below several reported trend measures: the 7-day SMA at $77.90, the 20-day SMA at $87.94, the 50-day SMA at $119.96, the 12-day EMA at $83.40, and the 26-day EMA at $96.03. In practical terms, the recent move improved short-term price action, but the higher time-frame structure still points below those averages.
 Technical structure
 The momentum readings in the supplied data are mixed but still weak. RSI(14) was 35.23, which the source labels as neutral, while the MACD was -12.6296 and the MACD histogram was 0.0000, which the source labels as bearish momentum. Stochastic %K was 23.51 and %D was 18.81, reinforcing a low-momentum setup rather than a confirmed upside trend.
 Bollinger Band data places SOXL near the lower end of its recent range. The upper band was $107.86, the middle band was $87.94, and the lower band was $68.02, with %B at 0.1938. That means the ETF was trading close to lower-band support rather than near the midpoint of its recent volatility envelope. The reported ATR(14) of $10.94 also indicates wide daily movement.
 Key levels from the supplied data
 The reported levels are:
 Strong resistance: $86.29
 Immediate resistance: $81.03
 Pivot point: $73.25
 Immediate support: $67.99
 Strong support: $60.21
 These levels frame the current setup. Price is still below the immediate resistance level, while the pivot and immediate support remain the nearest reference points on the downside. The lower Bollinger Band at $68.02 sits close to immediate support, which makes that area important in the current structure.
 Derivatives market observations
 The supplied derivatives data shows positive funding at 0.0138%, meaning longs are paying shorts in the Binance futures market observations. Open interest was 3,143,725.55 contracts, with an open interest value of $210,976,579, while 24-hour open interest changed by -6.41%. That combination suggests leverage was being reduced even as price bounced.
 The long/short ratios are heavily tilted long within the Binance cohorts reported in the data. Global accounts were 84.3% long and 15.7% short, with a ratio of 5.3857, while top-trader accounts were 87.6% long and 12.4% short, with a ratio of 7.0451. These figures describe the Binance cohorts in the source data; they do not describe underlying shareholder positioning in the ETF.

 The taker buy/sell ratio was 1.1060, with buy volume of 1,073,188 versus sell volume of 970,331. That shows aggressive buying pressure in the reported futures market observations, but the price and trend readings have not yet confirmed a stronger reversal.
 Conclusion
 the reported data points to a rally that is still running into overhead resistance from moving averages and momentum indicators. SOXL has rebounded from lower levels, but the ETF remains below its reported trend markers, and the futures-side open interest decline shows that the move has not yet been matched by expanding positioning. No significant price predictions were found recently in the supplied news flow, so the current read is based on the reported market data alone.
